about_the_game:
Join a puzzle-filled adventure where the only way to reclaim your old life is through communication and cooperation with your partner.

It all began when you were drugged and kidnapped after drinking your coffee. Your old lives were taken away, and now there's only one way back: play the game they want.

You must find a way to overcome puzzles and obstacles. After escaping a construction site, you’ll find yourselves stranded on an island in the middle of the sea. But your journey doesn’t end there. At the heart of the island lies an ancient cave from a lost civilization. The only thing you have is a communication device. The only way out is teamwork, sharp observation, and solid communication.

Features

  • Multiple puzzles: Work together to solve a variety of complex and unique puzzles.

  • Obstacles and parkour: Need to escape from somewhere? Don’t worry—your partner will always have your back.

  • Mysterious and atmospheric locations: An island in the middle of the sea, an ancient cave

  • Immersive story: Who are these people and why did they kidnap you? How will you reclaim your old lives?

  • Fun: Tired of running around and solving mind-bending puzzles with your partner? Take a moment to enjoy the atmosphere. Explore the area. Maybe what you need to escape this hopeless situation is... a little dance.

NOTE: This game is co-op only. Both players need a working microphone and an internet connection compatible with their computers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600@ 3.1 GHz or AMD R5 1600X @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600x 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A high-speed internet connection and a good connection between players are required to play online

short_description: While enjoying a peaceful evening, we suddenly find ourselves in an unknown place, forced to play a mysterious game. Should we play along with their rules? Can we truly reclaim our old lives—or are we trapped in this game forever?
supported_languages: English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish - Latin America, Italian, Polish
